comment.narrative:
Achievement: Share of comparable core economic and social statistics datasets produced and available for open access. The aggregate or average value is increased from 37 to 55.14 percent. Ghana produced 6 out of 7 datasets (86 percent); Liberia produced 3 out of 7 (43 percent); Sierra Leone produced 2 out of 7 (29 percent); Togo produced 4 out of 7 (57 percent); Cabo Verde produced 1 out of 7 (14 percent); Burkina Faso produced 6 out of 7 (86 percent); and Cote d'Ivoire produced 5 out of 7 (71 percent).
The list datasets include (1) an Anonymized cartography dataset; (2) an Anonymized household poverty survey, (3) a CPI dataset, (4) an Anonymized agricultural census or annual survey dataset, (5) an Anonymized updated business registry, (6) Input-output tables, and (7) Anonymized labor force surveys dataset. Open access means available to the users on a website or upon request. Statistics are comparable when produced using similar methodologies.
